report:
Ureter, right, ureterectomy

Received in formalin is a ureterectomy specimen comprising a segment of ureter measuring 45 mm in length and 8 mm in diameter. There is a papillary tumour in the lower ureter measuring 12 x 10 x 6 mm, 15 mm from the closest (distal ureteric) margin. Representative sections are taken in 6 blocks.

(1) Proximal ureteric margin.
(2) Distal ureteric margin.
(3-6) Tumour.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Ureterectomy
- Specimen laterality: Right
- Tumour site: Lower ureter
- Tumour size: 12 mm (greatest dimension)
- Tumour focality: Unifocal

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Papillary urothelial carcinoma, non-invasive
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a low-grade non-invasive papillary urothelial carcinoma. Slender papillae with fibrovascular cores and minimal fusion are lined by orderly urothelium with mild nuclear pleomorphism; mitoses are confined to the lower half. There is no stromal invasion.
- Histologic grade: Low grade
- Tumour configuration: Papillary
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Tumour extension: Non-invasive papillary carcinoma

Margins
- Proximal ureteric margin: Uninvolved (20 mm)
- Distal ureteric margin: Uninvolved (15 mm)
- Soft tissue margin: Uninvolved (5 mm)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pTa

Additional findings
- None identified

URETER, right, ureterectomy
- NON-INVASIVE PAPILLARY UROTHELIAL CARCINOMA of the lower ureter, low grade,
  12 mm; completely excised (closest margin 5 mm, soft tissue); see synoptic
  report
- pTa (AJCC 8th edition)

checks.message: Stage group, AJCC 8th edition (reference, not reported): not assignable - the regional node category is needed

MMR immunohistochemistry not performed. ICCR (Note 18) cites a review that recommends tissue testing (immunohistochemistry or molecular) when the patient is under 60, when there is a family history of upper tract urothelial, endometrial or colon cancer in a relative under 60, or when the patient has had colon or endometrial cancer; no screening protocol has been agreed.
